中国经济.content:
China's central bank added nearly 20 tonnes of gold to its reserves in July, marking its largest monthly purchase since October 2023 and extending an accumulation streak that now spans 21 consecutive months.

The People's Bank of China increased its holdings by 640,000 troy ounces, lifting total reserves to approximately 76.08 million ounces, or a record 2,366 tonnes. China has added about 60 tonnes since the beginning of 2026, including 10 tonnes in May and 15 tonnes in June.
